[Respondent]: We have reviewed your case, including the invoices and the screenshot you attached. According to our records, your PremierStream subscription and the "Sports Plus" add-on remained active and in use through June.

Our Terms of Service, which are accepted at signup and available in your account settings, specify that cancellations take effect only once the cancellation process is fully completed and a confirmation email is issued. The logs on our side do not show a completed cancellation as of April 3rd, and there is no record of a system error affecting your account.

Regarding the "Sports Plus" add-on, our system reflects that it was activated via an in-app promotion. These add-ons are optional and require user confirmation. Under our standard policy, charges incurred while services are active and available are valid.

That said, we recognize that you contacted support and that you believe you cancelled earlier. While we cannot agree to refund all six months of charges you are requesting, we are prepared to offer a one-month courtesy refund of the base subscription fee ($49.99) as a goodwill gesture. Your subscription has now been cancelled per your recent request, and the add-on has been removed going forward.

Please note that this offer is consistent with our policies and past practice. If you have additional documentation showing a completed cancellation confirmation before April’s billing date, you may upload it for further review.
